subject.title: [Feature]: Keep Codex app-server with Gateway for remote execution

question: Should OpenClaw accept the experimental Codex remote-execution topology implemented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101326, or should the issue stay open until maintainers narrow or defer the boundary?
rationale: The issue is not a narrow bug fix; it adds new config, SecretRef, remote execution, credential, and session-binding semantics that automation cannot accept as product/security direction.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental preview
options.body: Proceed through the open implementation candidate after explicit maintainer security/product acceptance and required cleanup/proof review.

options.title: Narrow the boundary first
options.body: Ask for a smaller design or PR that proves only the minimum remote exec-server topology before carrying all resume, command, and side-question behavior.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep this issue open as product backlog until upstream Codex registry contracts and OpenClaw operator policy are more settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental preview
recommendation.body: Proceed through the open implementation candidate after explicit maintainer security/product acceptance and required cleanup/proof review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the protected design issue and the current implementation candidate, with recent history on the Codex app-server lifecycle files that define the security boundary.
